Clean Title, Great Maintenance Records, Extra Winter Tires!

Selling our silver 2016 Hyundai Genesis. The vehicle currently has just under 75,000 miles on it and is being sold because the family members who primarily drove it have moved out of the country. I have the clean title in hand, ready for a smooth and legitimate transaction.

The car comes with service history records showing how well it has been mechanically cared for.

The Good:

- Powered by a 3.8L V6 engine.
- Sitting on relatively new Michelin Pilot Sport All-Season tires, which were mounted and balanced at 64k miles
- Includes a second set of winter tires (Toyo Observe GSi-6 HP) that have been properly stored indoors
- Extensive maintenance history is included and up-to-date. A four-wheel alignment and oil change were recently completed at 72,283 miles.
- Major preventative maintenance, including transmission fluid, coolant system, and fuel induction services, were all completed at 63,908 miles.
- The interior is exceptionally clean with well-kept leather seats
- The trunk is spacious, tidy, and includes the original first-aid kit.
- Comes with two (2) keys

The Imperfections (Full Transparency):

I want to be upfront about a few cosmetic and minor functional issues so there are no surprises:
- There is some visible damage/scuffing on the right side of the front bumper
- There are some scratches on the lower right passenger side, near the floor/rocker panel.
- The driver-side mirror does not fold in - The shark fin antenna on the roof fell off and was replaced; the replacement unit is fully functional but is a slightly different color.
- The trunk release handle is completely functional, but the plastic lever itself feels a bit cheap/non-premium.

Overall, this is a fantastic, comfortable, and highly reliable daily driver that has been meticulously serviced.

Payment will only be accepted via cash or cashier's check verified at the bank.

Please reach out for any questions or to see the car!

description:
If you're looking for a dependable, fuel-efficient, and comfortable midsize sedan, this 2016 Nissan Altima S is an excellent choice. The Altima is known for its smooth ride, spacious interior, and impressive gas mileage, making it a great vehicle for daily commuting, road trips, first-time drivers, students, or anyone wanting a reliable car without breaking the bank.

This Altima S is powered by Nissan's proven 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with an automatic transmission, providing a comfortable balance of performance and fuel economy. The cabin offers plenty of room for both front and rear passengers, along with a large trunk that easily accommodates luggage, groceries, sports equipment, or work gear.

Features include power windows and locks, cruise control, Bluetooth hands-free calling and audio streaming, keyless entry with push-button start, steering wheel-mounted controls, air conditioning, and a user-friendly infotainment system. The comfortable cloth seating and quiet interior make every drive enjoyable, whether you're commuting across town or traveling on the highway.

The exterior has a clean, timeless design that still looks modern today. Ford positioned this model at the upper end of the Mustang range for 2010, and the Shelby name indicates a focus on higher output and more capable chassis hardware than the standard car. The base trim keeps the equipment list direct and centered on the driving experience, without adding unnecessary complexity. It is the kind of vehicle whose identity is defined by its mechanical specification rather than by decorative extras.

Inside, the cabin includes leather seats and power seats. The seating surfaces give the interior a more finished appearance than a basic cloth setup, while the power adjustment allows the driver to set a preferred position with less effort. The materials and controls are arranged in a way that is consistent with a performance coupe that still needs to serve everyday use. The dash and center stack carry the familiar Ford design language from that period, with controls placed in a practical, easy-to-reach manner. The overall presentation is straightforward and centered on function, with a few comfort-oriented touches to accompany the car's more serious hardware.

The technology package includes Bluetooth and satellite radio ready capability. Bluetooth adds wireless connectivity for compatible phones, which was becoming a common feature in this era and remains useful for hands-free communication. Satellite radio ready indicates that the vehicle is equipped to accept satellite radio service with the proper subscription and activation. These items are integrated without changing the character of the car, and they provide a useful level of convenience for daily driving and longer trips. The interior also includes side impact airbags, reflecting the safety equipment that Ford supplied for this model year. That feature adds an important layer of occupant protection without drawing attention away from the rest of the cabin. Convenience and safety items are present, but they are not the main reason for selecting this vehicle. They sit alongside the mechanical content rather than replacing it.

Exterior details include fog lights, which are part of the front lighting equipment and sit within the car's familiar Shelby front-end treatment. The bodywork carries the cues associated with the GT500 badge, including a more aggressive front fascia, unique badging, and the proportions of a high-output Mustang coupe. The hardware beneath the body is what separates this car from lesser versions of the platform, with components selected to manage the increased power and support more assertive driving. The 2010 model year places it in the first generation of the modern GT500 run, which means it reflects Ford's approach at the time to combining strong straight-line performance with everyday usability. The result is a car with a clear mechanical identity, a small but useful set of comfort and connectivity features, and the equipment expected from a Shelby-badged Mustang of that period.

This 2025 Ford F-150 Raptor in Shelter Green represents a premium off-road truck built for those who demand performance and capability without compromise.

- Twin Panel Moonroof
- Equipment Group 802A Raptor 37 with Dual Valve Shocks
- Raptor 37 Unique 17 Cast Aluminum Wheels with bead lock capability
- 37x12.5R17 BSW All-Terrain Tires
- Carbon Fiber Interior Appliques
- Modular Front Bumper
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner
- 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged Engine with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- RECARO Alcantara Suede Front Seats with heating and ventilation
- B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- Electronic Locking Differential with 4.10 Axle Ratio
- Heated steering wheel and heated rear seats
- FordPass Connect 5G internet access capability
- Auto High-beam Headlights with fog lights

The twin turbocharged V6 engine delivers commanding power paired with a 10-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD, achieving 15 city and 18 highway MPG. The suspension system features dual valve shocks engineered for both on-road comfort and off-road articulation, while the 4.10 electronic locking differential with 4-wheel disc brakes and electronic stability control provide confident traction and stopping power.

Inside, the Raptor prioritizes driver comfort and technology. RECARO Alcantara suede front seats with heating and ventilation options keep you comfortable across any condition, while the heated steering wheel and heated rear seats extend that comfort throughout the cabin. The twin panel moonroof bathes the interior in natural light, and carbon fiber interior appliances add an upscale touch that reflects the truck's premium positioning.

Technology integration is seamless through SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition, connected navigation, and FordPass Connect 5G compatibility. The B&O Unleashed Sound System with 14 speakers delivers studio-quality audio through SiriusXM 360L, while the heads-up display provides critical information without diverting your attention from the road. Memory functions for the driver's seat, pedals, and steering wheel ensure your driving position is perfectly customized every time you climb behind the wheel.

The modular front bumper combines functionality with design flexibility, while the tough bed spray-in bedliner protects your cargo area for years of use. The 37x12.5R17 BSW all-terrain tires mounted on bead lock-capable 17-inch cast aluminum wheels tackle challenging terrain while maintaining on-road composure.

With 7,402 miles and a GVWR of 7,400 lbs, this Raptor is ready to serve your most demanding needs. The comprehensive safety suite includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, occupant sensing technology, and SYNC 4 911 Assist for connected emergency response.

This 2025 F-150 Raptor combines genuine capability with refined comfort and technology, delivering a truck that performs as well as it looks. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it fits your lifestyle and needs.

The 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LTZ immediately impresses with its confident, composed road manners that make even routine drives feel rewarding. Steering is direct and well-weighted, delivering reassuring feedback that instills trust on highways and winding back roads alike.

Enthusiasts who value driving feel and responsiveness will appreciate how the Silverado blends refinement with capability. The robust EcoTec3 5.3L V8 and 10-speed automatic transmission respond eagerly to throttle inputs, making merging and passing genuinely satisfying. With 4WD traction and the High Capacity Suspension Package, this truck inspires confidence whether cruising the interstate or tackling challenging terrain. Its clean CARFAX history and odometer reading of 52,254 miles further reinforce its appeal to drivers who want a proven, high-value vehicle that still delivers on engagement.

Every drive in this Silverado is defined by the harmonious pairing of its V8 engine and advanced 10-speed automatic. Throttle response is crisp, with the engine delivering smooth, linear power that feels robust underfoot. Shifts arrive quickly and seamlessly, especially when the Electronic Transmission Range Selector Shifter is used for more involved driving. Steering remains composed even at higher speeds, and the off-road suspension and front wheel independent setup help the truck settle confidently over uneven surfaces. Brake pedal feel is firm and progressive, providing consistent stopping power and enhancing driver control when the road demands it.

Safety technologies are seamlessly integrated to enhance, not hinder, the driving experience. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work unobtrusively in the background, assisting with grip and composure during spirited maneuvers or in challenging conditions. Automatic Emergency Braking and Forward Collision Alert heighten driver confidence by providing an extra layer of intervention during sudden stops. Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning supports attentive driving by gently nudging the truck back into its lane if needed, while Hill Descent Control and Trailer Side Blind Zone Alert lend peace of mind when managing heavy loads or navigating tight spaces. These systems act as an extension of the driver's intent, never diminishing the sense of involvement behind the wheel.

This Silverado LTZ is equipped with packages that directly benefit enthusiasts who savor time in the driver s seat. The Z71 Off-Road & Protection Package sharpens control and bolsters confidence on unpredictable surfaces, while the LTZ Convenience Package and LTZ Convenience Package II add comfort features such as heated and ventilated front seats and a heated steering wheel for year-round enjoyment.

Against rivals like the Ford F-150 Lariat and Ram 1500 Laramie, the Silverado LTZ stands out for its engaging steering calibration and responsive 10-speed transmission.

How composed does it feel on the highway? The Silverado maintains a steady, planted demeanor at speed, minimizing body movement and soaking up expansion joints with precision. Is the ride comfortable for long drives? Supportive perforated leather-appointed front seats and dual-zone climate control ensure fatigue-free hours behind the wheel.

Experience the rewards of driving a Silverado that s engineered for involvement at Bayway Chevrolet, 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581. Call to arrange a test drive and discover how every commute and road trip can become a more engaging, memorable journey.
